fusions.name: Hind Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks out all around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bolt Through
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and hit it for 14 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolting Sprint
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Springy Step
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
